behaviors: User can sign up with email/password
User can log in with email/password
Protected routes redirect to login if no session
side_effects: Creates user record in Supabase auth.users
Sets auth token in browser storage
Triggers React Query cache invalidation on logout

assumptions: Supabase Auth supports email/password out of the box
Browser localStorage is acceptable for session persistence

spec.decision: Use Supabase Auth for all authentication operations
constraints: Must support email/password only (no OAuth for MVP)
Must handle auth errors gracefully with user-friendly messages
spec.rationale: Supabase Auth provides secure, production-ready authentication without custom backend code

meta.notes: Auth contract handoff from Planner to Coordinator. Defines behavioral expectations for auth feature.
